primary_endpoint: heldout_roi, full common-9 mean IoU, abstentions counted as wrong
selection: Freeze before scoring. One sequence, one parameter set, no GT selection. Same corrected geometry and prediction files in every arm.
semantics: Top-1 confidence evidence, not reconstructed full softmax probabilities. One mean vote per scan/voxel, one per five-frame group, then one per visit with range reliability.
causality: Offline semantic mapping with future revisits; not single-scan or causal online inference.
training: No training, no pseudo-label feedback from evaluated sequence, no changes to B0 weights.
